xian.tagline_zh: 十三朝古都，丝绸之路的东方起点
xian.tagline_en: The ancient capital of thirteen dynasties and the eastern starting point of the Silk Road
xian.history_zh: 西安古称长安，先后有周、秦、汉、唐等十三个朝代在此建都，是中国历史上建都朝代最多、时间最长的古都。汉长安城曾是当时世界上规模最大的城市之一，盛唐时期的长安人口逾百万，各国使节、商旅云集，呈现万国来朝的盛况。被誉为世界第八大奇迹的秦始皇兵马俑，至今仍在骊山脚下守护着千古一帝的陵寝。
xian.history_en: Known in antiquity as Chang'an, Xi'an served as the capital of thirteen dynasties, including the Zhou, Qin, Han and Tang, making it China's longest-standing ancient capital. Han Chang'an was once among the largest cities in the world, and Tang Chang'an, with a population of over one million, drew envoys and merchants from every corner of Asia in a grand confluence of nations. The Terracotta Army, hailed as the Eighth Wonder of the World, still guards the tomb of the First Emperor beneath Mount Li.
xian.geography_zh: 西安地处关中平原腹地、渭河南岸，南依秦岭，素有「八水绕长安」之说。
xian.geography_en: Xi'an lies in the heart of the Guanzhong Plain on the south bank of the Wei River, with the Qinling Mountains to the south and eight rivers ringing the ancient city.
xian.climate_zh: 属温带季风气候，四季分明，冬冷夏热，春秋短暂，其中秋季天高气爽，最宜游览。
xian.climate_en: The climate is temperate monsoonal with four distinct seasons: cold winters, hot summers and brief springs and autumns, with autumn the most pleasant time to visit.
attractions_en: Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum (Terracotta Army)
Giant Wild Goose Pagoda & Daci'en Temple
food_en: Yangrou paomo (lamb soup with crumbled flatbread)

guide_zh.title: 城墙·钟鼓楼·回民街
items: 租一辆自行车绕西安城墙骑行，一览古城内外风光。
登临钟鼓楼，感受西安城市中心六百年的地标气派。
傍晚钻进回民街，从羊肉泡馍、肉夹馍一路吃到凉皮和柿子饼。

guide_zh.title: 兵马俑·华清宫
items: 上午前往临潼，参观秦始皇兵马俑博物馆，近距离感受两千多年前的地下军阵。
午后游览华清宫，重温唐玄宗与杨贵妃的温泉行宫往事。
晚上观看实景演出《长恨歌》，在骊山脚下梦回盛唐。

guide_zh.title: 陕西历史博物馆·大雁塔·大唐不夜城
items: 上午在陕西历史博物馆细看周秦汉唐的文物精华。
午后登大雁塔，凭栏远眺千年长安。
入夜漫步大唐不夜城，在璀璨灯火中梦回盛唐。

guide_en.title: City Wall · Bell & Drum Towers · Muslim Quarter
items: Rent a bicycle and ride the full circuit of the Xi'an City Wall, taking in views of the old city on both sides.
Climb the Bell and Drum Towers, the landmark pairing that has marked the city center for six centuries.
Finish the day in the Muslim Quarter, working your way through yangrou paomo, roujiamo and liangpi.

guide_en.title: Terracotta Army · Huaqing Palace
items: Spend the morning in Lintong at the Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum, face to face with the 2,000-year-old terracotta legions.
In the afternoon, explore Huaqing Palace, the Tang-era hot spring retreat of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.
In the evening, watch the live show Song of Everlasting Sorrow beneath Mount Li and be transported back to the golden age of Tang.

guide_en.title: Shaanxi History Museum · Giant Wild Goose Pagoda · Great Tang All Day Mall
items: Start the morning at the Shaanxi History Museum with treasures spanning the Zhou, Qin, Han and Tang dynasties.
In the afternoon, climb the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda and gaze over the city of Chang'an.
After dark, stroll the Great Tang All Day Mall, where lanterns and street performers evoke the Tang capital at its height.

beijing.tagline_zh: 三千年建城史，元明清三代帝都
beijing.tagline_en: Three thousand years of city history, and the imperial capital of the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties
beijing.history_zh: 北京建城已逾三千年，从燕国蓟城、唐代幽州，到辽南京、金中都，始终是北方重镇。元世祖忽必烈定都大都，奠定了此后北京城的基本格局；明清两代在此营建紫禁城，六百年皇城气象延续至今。如今北京中轴线成功申遗，让世界再次看见这座古都的营城智慧。
beijing.history_en: Beijing's recorded history as a city spans more than three thousand years, from the Ji City of the Yan state and Youzhou of the Tang to the Southern Capital of the Liao and the Central Capital of the Jin. When Kublai Khan founded Dadu, the Great Capital of the Yuan, he laid down the blueprint of the city we know today, and the Ming and Qing courts raised the Forbidden City at its heart, six centuries of imperial splendor that endures to this day. The recent inscription of Beijing's Central Axis on the World Heritage List has brought this ancient capital's urban planning genius renewed global acclaim.
beijing.geography_zh: 北京位于华北平原北端，西靠太行、北依燕山，城区坐落于永定河冲积扇之上。
beijing.geography_en: Beijing sits at the northern edge of the North China Plain, sheltered by the Taihang Mountains to the west and the Yan Mountains to the north, on the alluvial fan of the Yongding River.
beijing.climate_zh: 属暖温带半湿润季风气候，春季短暂多风，夏季炎热多雨，秋季天高气爽最宜人，冬季寒冷干燥。
beijing.climate_en: The climate is warm-temperate and semi-humid monsoonal: springs are short and windy, summers hot and rainy, autumns crisp and clear, and winters cold and dry.
food_en: Douzhi with jiaoquan (fermented mung-bean milk and fried dough rings)

guide_zh.title: 天安门·故宫·景山
items: 清晨经天安门进入故宫，沿中轴线游览太和殿、中和殿与保和殿。
出神武门，登上景山万春亭，俯瞰紫禁城全貌与壮丽的中轴线。

guide_zh.title: 八达岭长城·明十三陵
items: 上午前往八达岭长城，登临好汉坡，感受燕山雄关的磅礴气势。
下午参观明十三陵，在定陵地宫探寻明代帝王的陵寝规制。

guide_zh.title: 天坛·颐和园·什刹海
items: 清晨到天坛公园，看祈年殿的蓝色琉璃瓦，感受祭天建筑的庄重。
午后游览颐和园，泛舟昆明湖，登万寿山远眺西山。
傍晚钻进什刹海的胡同，坐三轮车、听京腔，体验老北京生活。

guide_en.title: Tian'anmen · Forbidden City · Jingshan
items: Enter the Forbidden City through Tian'anmen in the morning and follow the central axis past the Hall of Supreme Harmony and the inner palaces.
Exit through the Gate of Divine Might and climb to Wanchun Pavilion on Jingshan Hill for the classic panorama of the palace roofs and the Central Axis.

guide_en.title: Badaling Great Wall · Ming Tombs
items: Head to Badaling in the morning and climb its steepest ramparts to feel the might of the passes in the Yan Mountains.
Spend the afternoon at the Ming Tombs, descending into the underground palace at Dingling to see how Ming emperors were laid to rest.

guide_en.title: Temple of Heaven · Summer Palace · Shichahai
items: Start the day at the Temple of Heaven, where the blue-glazed Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests embodies the solemnity of imperial sacrifice.
In the afternoon, drift across Kunming Lake in the Summer Palace and climb Longevity Hill for views of the Western Hills.
Come evening, wander the hutongs around Shichahai — take a rickshaw ride and soak up old Beijing life.

luoyang.tagline_zh: 十三朝古都，华夏文明的源头之一
luoyang.tagline_en: The ancient capital of thirteen dynasties and one of the cradles of Chinese civilization
luoyang.history_zh: 洛阳地处天下之中，夏、商、周三代皆曾建都于此，东汉、北魏亦定鼎河洛，隋唐时期更升为东都。作为丝绸之路的东方起点之一，洛阳见证了东西方文明的千年交融。始建于东汉的白马寺是中国第一古刹，龙门石窟则以十多万尊造像跻身世界文化遗产。
luoyang.history_en: Luoyang, lying at the heart of the Central Plains, served as capital to the Xia, Shang and Zhou dynasties, and later to the Eastern Han and Northern Wei; under the Sui and Tang it rose again as the Eastern Capital. As one of the eastern starting points of the Silk Road, Luoyang witnessed a thousand years of exchange between East and West. The White Horse Temple, founded in the Eastern Han, is the first Buddhist temple in China, while the Longmen Grottoes, with over one hundred thousand statues, stand as a World Heritage masterpiece.
luoyang.geography_zh: 洛阳地处伊洛盆地，位于黄河之南，洛水穿城而过，北有邙山为天然屏障。
luoyang.geography_en: Luoyang occupies the Yi-Luo Basin south of the Yellow River, with the Luo River flowing through the city and Mount Mang standing guard to the north.
luoyang.climate_zh: 属暖温带季风气候，四季分明，每年四月牡丹盛放时节最是动人。
luoyang.climate_en: The climate is warm-temperate monsoonal with four distinct seasons; the city is at its most enchanting in April, when the peonies burst into bloom.

guide_zh.title: 龙门石窟·关林
items: 上午游览龙门石窟，在伊水两岸仰望卢舍那大佛的慈悲微笑。
下午前往关林，拜谒关羽葬首之所，在古柏林中感受忠义之气。

guide_zh.title: 白马寺·应天门·老城十字街
items: 上午参观白马寺，在「中国第一古刹」里感受佛教初传的印记。
傍晚登应天门，俯瞰隋唐洛阳城遗址，遥想武则天时代的盛景。
晚上到老城十字街，尝一碗牛肉汤，感受洛阳烟火气。

guide_zh.title: 洛阳博物馆·牡丹园
items: 上午在洛阳博物馆梳理河洛文明脉络。
若逢四月花季，下午到牡丹园赏「洛阳牡丹甲天下」的国色天香。

guide_en.title: Longmen Grottoes · Guanlin
items: Spend the morning at the Longmen Grottoes, gazing up at the serene smile of the Vairocana Buddha above the Yi River.
In the afternoon visit Guanlin Temple, the resting place of Guan Yu's head, and feel the spirit of loyalty among the ancient cypresses.

guide_en.title: White Horse Temple · Yingtian Gate · Old Town Cross Street
items: Visit the White Horse Temple in the morning and trace the first footsteps of Buddhism in China.
Climb Yingtian Gate at dusk to survey the ruins of Sui-Tang Luoyang and imagine the city at its height.
End the day on Cross Street in the old town, slurping a bowl of beef soup amid the lively night market.

guide_en.title: Luoyang Museum · Peony Garden
items: Spend the morning at the Luoyang Museum tracing the story of Heluo civilization.
If you visit in April, spend the afternoon among the peonies — the blooms of Luoyang are celebrated as the finest under heaven.

nanjing.tagline_en: The ancient capital of six dynasties and a metropolis of ten
nanjing.history_zh: 南京古称建业、建康，东吴在此开国，东晋与南朝相继定都，遂有「六朝古都」之名。明太祖朱元璋定鼎南京，这里也成为郑和下西洋的出发地。近代以来南京风云际会，先后见证太平天国建都与中华民国定都，是中国近现代史绕不开的名字。
nanjing.history_en: Known in antiquity as Jianye and Jiankang, Nanjing became the capital of the Eastern Wu, and then of the Eastern Jin and the Southern Dynasties, earning its name as the ancient capital of six dynasties. The Ming founder Zhu Yuanzhang made it his capital, and it was from here that Zheng He's treasure fleets set sail. In modern times the city has stood at the center of the national story, serving as the capital of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and later of the Republic of China.
nanjing.geography_zh: 南京位于长江下游南岸，东有紫金山如龙蟠，西有石头城似虎踞，秦淮河穿城而过。
nanjing.geography_en: Nanjing lies on the south bank of the lower Yangtze, with Purple Mountain coiling like a dragon to the east and Stone City crouching like a tiger to the west, while the Qinhuai River threads through the city.
nanjing.climate_zh: 属亚热带季风气候，冬季温和、夏季炎热，梅雨季节湿润多雨，春秋两季最为舒适。
nanjing.climate_en: The climate is subtropical monsoonal, with mild winters, hot summers and a humid plum-rain season; spring and autumn are the most comfortable times to visit.
food_en: Red bean and glutinous rice ball soup

guide_zh.title: 中山陵·明孝陵
items: 上午登紫金山谒中山陵，沿三百九十二级台阶而上，俯瞰钟山风光。
下午沿神道石象路访明孝陵，在梧桐林深处感受明初皇陵气象。

guide_zh.title: 总统府·南京博物院
items: 上午参观总统府，从两江总督署到民国总统府，读一部中国近代史。
下午在南京博物院细赏六朝文物，再逛一逛复原的民国馆。

guide_zh.title: 夫子庙·秦淮河·中华门
items: 上午逛夫子庙，拜文庙、尝金陵小吃。
午后登中华门瓮城，在明代城墙上俯瞰秦淮风光。
入夜乘画舫夜游秦淮河，看桨声灯影里的金陵旧梦。

guide_en.title: Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum · Ming Xiaoling
items: Climb Purple Mountain in the morning to pay respects at the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum, ascending its 392 steps for sweeping views of the hills.
In the afternoon, walk the Sacred Way to the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, its stone animals standing among deep groves of plane trees.

guide_en.title: Presidential Palace · Nanjing Museum
items: Spend the morning at the Presidential Palace, which tells the story of modern China from viceroy's office to republican seat of government.
In the afternoon, admire Six Dynasties treasures at the Nanjing Museum and wander its recreated Republic-era street.

guide_en.title: Confucius Temple & Qinhuai River · Zhonghua Gate
items: Visit the Confucius Temple in the morning, then sample classic Nanjing snacks in the surrounding streets.
In the afternoon, climb the Zhonghua Gate Castle and walk the Ming city wall above the Qinhuai River.
After dark, board a painted boat for a night cruise on the Qinhuai, where lantern light and oars carry echoes of old Jinling.

kaifeng.tagline_zh: 八朝古都，北宋汴京清明上河图之地
kaifeng.tagline_en: The capital of eight dynasties, and the Bianjing of the Northern Song in Along the River During the Qingming Festival
kaifeng.history_zh: 开封古称大梁，战国时为魏国都城，五代与北宋相继定都于此。北宋汴京人口逾百万，是当时世界上最大的城市，市井繁华被张择端绘入传世名画《清明上河图》。
kaifeng.history_en: Kaifeng, known in antiquity as Daliang, was the capital of the Wei state in the Warring States period and later of the Five Dynasties and the Northern Song. Bianjing, as it was called in Song times, had a population of over a million and was then the largest city in the world — a bustle of shops and canals immortalized in Zhang Zeduan's masterpiece Along the River During the Qingming Festival.
kaifeng.geography_zh: 开封地处黄河之南的豫东平原，汴河漕运故道穿城而过，城市因水而兴。
kaifeng.geography_en: Kaifeng sits on the plains of eastern Henan, south of the Yellow River, with the old Bian Canal waterway running through the city that rose on its commerce.
kaifeng.climate_zh: 属暖温带季风气候，四季分明，春秋两季最宜出行。
kaifeng.climate_en: The climate is warm-temperate monsoonal with four distinct seasons; spring and autumn are the best times to visit.

guide_zh.title: 清明上河园
items: 全天沉浸式游览清明上河园，实景重现《清明上河图》中的汴京繁华。
观看包公巡视、王员外招婿等宋代市井演出，还可换上宋装拍照留念。

guide_zh.title: 开封府·大相国寺
items: 上午逛开封府，看包青天升堂断案的演出。
下午游大相国寺，这座千年古刹曾是北宋皇家寺院。

guide_zh.title: 铁塔·龙亭·夜市
items: 上午登铁塔公园，看千年琉璃塔的风采。
午后游龙亭，俯瞰潘杨二湖与开封古城。
晚上到鼓楼夜市，吃灌汤包、炒凉粉，尝遍汴京风味。

guide_en.title: Millennium City Park
items: Spend the whole day inside the Millennium City Park, a living reconstruction of the Song capital painted in the Qingming scroll.
Watch street performances such as Lord Bao's inspection tour, and rent Song-dynasty costume for a photo.

guide_en.title: Kaifeng Prefecture · Daxiangguo Temple
items: Visit Kaifeng Prefecture in the morning and watch the courtroom show in which Lord Bao metes out justice.
In the afternoon explore Daxiangguo Temple, the thousand-year-old monastery that once served as the royal temple of the Northern Song.

guide_en.title: Iron Pagoda · Dragon Pavilion · Night Market
items: Admire the thousand-year-old Iron Pagoda — actually built of glazed brick — in its namesake park.
Climb the Dragon Pavilion in the afternoon for views over Lakes Pan and Yang and the old city.
Finish at the Drum Tower night market, feasting on soup buns and stir-fried bean jelly.

hangzhou.tagline_en: Paradise on earth and the Lin'an of the Southern Song
hangzhou.history_zh: 杭州曾是五代吴越国的都城，南宋迁都后以临安为行在，成为一时无两的政治文化中心。马可·波罗游历至此，盛赞它是「世界上最华贵之城」。作为京杭大运河的南端，杭州自古便是江南漕运与商贸的枢纽。
hangzhou.history_en: Hangzhou was the capital of the Wuyue kingdom in the Five Dynasties era, and when the Southern Song court moved south it ruled from Lin'an, making the city the political and cultural center of China. Marco Polo, who visited at its height, praised it as the finest and most splendid city in the world. As the southern terminus of the Grand Canal, Hangzhou has long been a hub of canal transport and trade in the Jiangnan region.
hangzhou.geography_zh: 杭州地处钱塘江入海口，西湖被群山环抱，湖光山色与江南水乡景致浑然一体。
hangzhou.geography_en: Hangzhou lies at the mouth of the Qiantang River, with West Lake embraced by rolling hills — a picture-postcard blend of mountain, water and Jiangnan water-town scenery.
hangzhou.climate_zh: 属亚热带季风气候，湿润温和，春秋最美，夏季有梅雨季。
hangzhou.climate_en: The climate is subtropical monsoonal, humid and mild; spring and autumn are the loveliest seasons, while early summer brings the plum rains.
attractions_zh: 西湖（苏堤/断桥/三潭印月）
attractions_en: West Lake (Su Causeway / Broken Bridge / Three Pools Mirroring the Moon)
Hangzhou section of the Grand Canal
food_en: West Lake fish in vinegar sauce

guide_zh.title: 西湖环湖
items: 沿苏堤漫步或骑行，一路遍览西湖十景。
乘游船登上湖心小岛，近距离欣赏三潭印月。
傍晚在断桥看日落，回味白娘子的传说。

guide_zh.title: 灵隐寺·龙井茶园
items: 上午访灵隐寺，在飞来峰下礼佛，欣赏历代石窟造像。
下午到龙井村茶园，泡一杯明前龙井，看茶山叠翠。

guide_zh.title: 京杭大运河·桥西历史街区
items: 乘漕舫船游览京杭大运河杭州段，感受千年漕运的余韵。
上岸漫步桥西历史街区，逛刀剪剑博物馆、尝一碗片儿川。

guide_en.title: West Lake Loop
items: Walk or cycle the length of Su Causeway, ticking off the Ten Scenes of West Lake as you go.
Take a boat to the lake islands for a close look at the Three Pools Mirroring the Moon.
Catch the sunset at the Broken Bridge and recall the legend of the White Snake.

guide_en.title: Lingyin Temple · Longjing Tea Terraces
items: Visit Lingyin Temple in the morning, paying respects beneath Feilai Peak among centuries of rock-carved Buddhas.
In the afternoon head to Longjing village, where you can steep a cup of early-spring tea overlooking the emerald terraces.

guide_en.title: Grand Canal · Qiaoxi Historic District
items: Cruise the Hangzhou section of the Grand Canal aboard a canal boat and feel the lingering rhythm of a thousand years of waterborne trade.
Step ashore to wander Qiaoxi Historic District, browsing its knife-and-scissors museum and stopping for a bowl of Pian'er Chuan noodles.

anyang.tagline_en: The last capital of the Shang dynasty and the birthplace of oracle bone script
anyang.history_zh: 安阳殷墟是商代晚期的都城遗址，是中国最早有文字可考的都城。甲骨文正是在这里被发现，把中国信史向前推进到了商代。安阳境内还有魏晋时期的邺城遗址，曾是六朝古都之一。
anyang.history_en: Anyang's Yinxu — the Yin Ruins — was the capital of the late Shang dynasty and the earliest Chinese city confirmed by written records. It was here that the oracle bone inscriptions were discovered, extending China's recorded history back to the Shang. Anyang also encompasses the ruins of Ye, the great city of the Cao Wei and later regimes and one of the six-dynasty capitals.
anyang.geography_zh: 安阳地处豫北平原，位于太行山东麓，古老的洹水从城北缓缓流过。
anyang.geography_en: Anyang lies on the plains of northern Henan at the eastern foot of the Taihang Mountains, with the ancient Huan River flowing quietly along the city's north side.
anyang.climate_zh: 属暖温带季风气候，四季分明。
anyang.climate_en: The climate is warm-temperate monsoonal, with four distinct seasons.

guide_zh.title: 殷墟·中国文字博物馆
items: 上午参观殷墟博物院，走进商代宫殿宗庙遗址，看甲骨文与青铜器的发现地。
下午到中国文字博物馆，从甲骨文到现代汉字，看尽三千年的文字演变。

guide_zh.title: 曹操高陵·文峰塔
items: 上午探访曹操高陵，了解一代枭雄的葬制与身后之谜。
下午登文峰塔，俯瞰安阳老城风光。

guide_zh.title: 红旗渠
items: 全天前往林州红旗渠，沿渠而行，感受人工天河的震撼。
参观青年洞，重温当年修渠人的奋斗精神。

guide_en.title: Yinxu Museum · National Museum of Chinese Writing
items: Visit the Yinxu Museum in the morning and walk through the palace and temple foundations of the Shang capital, where the oracle bones and bronzes were unearthed.
In the afternoon, follow three thousand years of Chinese script at the National Museum of Chinese Writing, from oracle bone to modern characters.

guide_en.title: Cao Cao's Mausoleum · Wenfeng Pagoda
items: Explore Cao Cao's Mausoleum in the morning and unravel the burial secrets of the famous warlord.
In the afternoon, climb Wenfeng Pagoda for a view over the old city of Anyang.

guide_en.title: Red Flag Canal
items: Devote the whole day to the Red Flag Canal in Linzhou, walking beside a waterway carved by hand through sheer cliffs.
Visit Youth Cave and hear the story of the laborers who built this modern marvel.

chengdu.tagline_en: The Land of Abundance and the ancient capital of Shu Han
chengdu.history_zh: 成都自古是古蜀文明的中心，金沙遗址与三星堆共同书写了灿烂的古蜀篇章。秦汉置蜀郡，三国时刘备在此建立蜀汉。唐代成都富庶繁华，与扬州并称「扬一益二」，杜甫笔下的「花重锦官城」流传千年。
chengdu.history_en: Chengdu has long been the heartland of the ancient Shu civilization, whose splendor is written in the bronzes of Sanxingdui and the gold of Jinsha. Under the Qin and Han it became the seat of Shu Commandery, and in the Three Kingdoms era Liu Bei made it the capital of Shu Han. By the Tang dynasty the city ranked with Yangzhou as the richest in the empire (Yang first, Yi second), and Du Fu's verse on the flower-laden City of Brocade has been recited for a thousand years.
chengdu.geography_zh: 成都坐落于成都平原、岷江冲积扇上，都江堰水利工程灌溉这片沃野已逾两千年。
chengdu.geography_en: Chengdu sits on the Chengdu Plain, an alluvial fan of the Min River, where the Dujiangyan irrigation system has watered these fertile fields for more than two thousand years.
chengdu.climate_zh: 属亚热带湿润季风气候，冬暖夏凉，多云雾少日照，四季皆可游览。
chengdu.climate_en: The climate is subtropical, humid and monsoonal, with mild winters, cool summers and plentiful cloud and mist; the city can be enjoyed in any season.
attractions_en: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
food_en: Fuqi Feipian (sliced beef and offal in chili oil)

guide_zh.title: 武侯祠·锦里
items: 上午游武侯祠，拜谒诸葛亮，走过三国文化长廊。
午后逛紧邻的锦里古街，看川剧变脸，尝地道小吃。

guide_zh.title: 大熊猫基地·宽窄巷子
items: 清晨前往大熊猫繁育研究基地，看熊猫吃竹、爬树、嬉戏打闹。
下午回市区逛宽窄巷子，在茶馆喝盖碗茶、掏耳朵，体验成都慢生活。

guide_zh.title: 都江堰·青城山
items: 上午赴都江堰，看两千年前的水利工程如何润泽天府之国。
午后登青城山，在幽静的道观与林间寻一份清静。

guide_en.title: Wuhou Shrine · Jinli
items: Visit the Wuhou Shrine in the morning to pay respects to Zhuge Liang and walk the corridor of Three Kingdoms history.
In the afternoon, wander next-door Jinli Ancient Street, catching a Sichuan opera face-changing show and sampling street snacks.

guide_en.title: Panda Base · Kuanzhai Alleys
items: Get to the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding early to watch pandas munch bamboo, climb trees and tumble over one another.
Back in town, while away the afternoon in the Kuanzhai Alleys: sip gaiwan tea in a teahouse and try a traditional ear cleaning for the full Chengdu slow-life experience.

guide_en.title: Dujiangyan · Mount Qingcheng
items: Head to Dujiangyan in the morning to see how a two-thousand-year-old irrigation scheme still waters the Land of Abundance.
In the afternoon, climb Mount Qingcheng, seeking quiet among its ancient Taoist temples and forested paths.

suzhou.tagline_en: The Venice of the East and the city of classical gardens
suzhou.history_zh: 苏州古称姑苏，春秋时为吴国都城，吴王阖闾命伍子胥筑城，建城史已有两千五百余年。唐代大诗人白居易出任苏州刺史，开凿山塘河、筑起山塘街，留下了「七里山塘」的佳话。明清两代苏州成为江南的经济文化中心，商贾云集，文风鼎盛。如今苏州古典园林作为世界文化遗产，被誉为「咫尺之内再造乾坤」。
suzhou.history_en: Known in antiquity as Gusu, Suzhou was the capital of the Wu state in the Spring and Autumn period, founded by Wu Zixu on the order of King Helu more than 2,500 years ago. In the Tang dynasty, the great poet Bai Juyi, serving here as governor, dredged the Shantang Canal and built Shantang Street, leaving behind the celebrated Seven-li Shantang. By the Ming and Qing dynasties, Suzhou had become the economic and cultural heart of the Jiangnan region, drawing merchants and scholars alike. Today its classical gardens, inscribed as World Heritage, are celebrated as miniature universes recreated within a walled plot.
suzhou.geography_zh: 苏州地处太湖之滨，水网密布，京杭大运河穿城而过，是一座名副其实的东方水城。
suzhou.geography_en: Suzhou lies on the shores of Lake Tai, laced by a dense web of waterways, with the Grand Canal threading through the city — a true water city of the East.
suzhou.climate_zh: 属亚热带季风气候，湿润温和，四季皆有景致，春秋两季最宜游览。
suzhou.climate_en: The climate is subtropical monsoonal, humid and mild; the city is lovely in every season, with spring and autumn the best times to visit.

guide_zh.title: 拙政园·苏州博物馆
items: 上午游拙政园，看亭台水榭、曲桥回廊，感受明代园林移步换景的妙趣。
下午参观紧邻的苏州博物馆，在贝聿铭的白墙灰瓦之间赏文物、品江南意境。

guide_zh.title: 虎丘·留园
items: 上午登虎丘，看千年斜塔云岩寺塔，听吴王阖闾与剑池的传说。
下午游留园，在冠云峰前体会苏州园林叠山理水的极致。

guide_zh.title: 平江路·山塘街夜游
items: 午后沿平江路逛水巷，乘手摇船穿过一座座小桥，听一曲评弹。
入夜游山塘街，灯笼映水，尝一碗糖粥，感受七里山塘的烟火气。

guide_en.title: Humble Administrator's Garden · Suzhou Museum
items: Spend the morning in the Humble Administrator's Garden, wandering its pavilions, bridges and ponds as the scenery unfolds at every turn.
In the afternoon, visit the adjoining Suzhou Museum, where I. M. Pei's modern architecture converses with the classical gardens.

guide_en.title: Tiger Hill · Lingering Garden
items: Climb Tiger Hill in the morning to see the leaning Yunyan Pagoda and hear the legend of King Helu's Sword Pool.
In the afternoon, explore the Lingering Garden and marvel at the artful rockeries around Guan Yun Peak.

guide_en.title: Pingjiang Road · Shantang Street at Night
items: Stroll the water lanes of Pingjiang Road in the afternoon, gliding under little stone bridges in a hand-rowed boat as pingtan ballads drift by.
After dark, wander Shantang Street, where lanterns shimmer on the canal; warm up with a bowl of sweet rice porridge.

yangzhou.tagline_en: The celebrated capital east of the Huai and the fair land west of the bamboo groves
yangzhou.history_zh: 扬州古称广陵，汉代已是江淮重镇；隋炀帝开凿大运河并三下江都，扬州由此迅速崛起。唐代扬州盐商云集、富甲天下，与益州并称「扬一益二」。杜牧笔下的「二十四桥明月夜，玉人何处教吹箫」，写尽了这座千年名都的繁华与风流。
yangzhou.history_en: Yangzhou, known in antiquity as Guangling, was already a strategic hub of the Huai region in Han times. When Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Grand Canal and visited Jiangdu on his southern tours, the city rose to prominence. By the Tang dynasty it was thronged with wealthy salt merchants and ranked with Chengdu as the richest city in the empire. Du Mu's verse — "a moonlit night on the Twenty-Four Bridge, where were fair maidens taught to play the flute" — distills the splendor and romance of this storied capital.
yangzhou.geography_zh: 扬州地处江淮平原，位于长江与京杭大运河交汇之处，自古为南北水运的枢纽。
yangzhou.geography_en: Yangzhou sits on the Jianghuai Plain at the meeting point of the Yangtze and the Grand Canal, long a linchpin of north-south water transport.
yangzhou.climate_zh: 属亚热带季风气候，四季分明，「烟花三月」的春天是扬州最美的季节。
yangzhou.climate_en: The climate is subtropical monsoonal with four distinct seasons; the misty, blossom-filled third month of spring is the city at its loveliest.
food_en: Steamed buns with three diced fillings

guide_zh.title: 瘦西湖·大明寺
items: 上午泛舟瘦西湖，从长堤春柳一路赏到五亭桥与白塔。
午后登蜀冈访大明寺，拜谒鉴真纪念堂，感受千年古刹的庄严。
傍晚在湖畔等一场夕阳，看「二十四桥明月夜」的诗意重现。

guide_zh.title: 个园·东关街
items: 上午游个园，在四季假山之间走完春夏秋冬的园林轮回。
午后沿东关街漫步，从老字号到小吃摊，尝一口地道的扬州味道。

guide_zh.title: 何园·皮市街
items: 上午游何园，穿过复道回廊，感受晚清第一名园的巧思。
午后逛皮市街的文创小店，在咖啡馆里消磨一个悠闲的扬州下午。

guide_en.title: Slender West Lake · Daming Temple
items: Take a boat ride on Slender West Lake, drifting from the Spring Willows along the Long Dyke to the Five Pavilion Bridge and the White Dagoba.
In the afternoon, climb Shugang Hill to Daming Temple and pay your respects at the Jianzhen Memorial Hall.
Stay for sunset by the lake, when the moonlit poetry of the Twenty-Four Bridge comes alive.

guide_en.title: Geyuan Garden · Dongguan Street
items: Wander Geyuan Garden in the morning, passing through all four seasons in its quartet of rockeries.
In the afternoon, stroll the old commercial thoroughfare of Dongguan Street, sampling local snacks as you go.

guide_en.title: Heyuan Garden · Pishi Street
items: Explore Heyuan Garden in the morning, threading its covered corridors — the finest late-Qing garden of hidden vistas.
Spend the afternoon browsing the boutique shops and cafés of Pishi Street, at an easy Yangzhou pace.

shaoxing.tagline_en: The bridge capital of the water towns and the hometown of celebrated scholars
shaoxing.history_zh: 绍兴古称会稽，春秋时为越国都城，勾践卧薪尝胆的故事就发生在这里。东晋永和九年，王羲之与友人在兰亭雅集，写下被誉为天下第一行书的《兰亭集序》。近代以来，绍兴走出了鲁迅、蔡元培等一大批名士，鲁迅故里至今游人如织。绍兴还是黄酒的发源地，酒香浸润这座古城已逾千年。
shaoxing.history_en: Shaoxing, known in antiquity as Kuaiji, was the capital of the Yue state, home to the story of King Goujian sleeping on brushwood and tasting gall. In the Eastern Jin, Wang Xizhi gathered with friends at the Orchid Pavilion and composed the Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection, the finest piece of running-script calligraphy in history. In modern times the city produced a galaxy of luminaries including Lu Xun and Cai Yuanpei, and Lu Xun's former home remains a beloved pilgrimage site. Shaoxing is also the birthplace of yellow rice wine, whose aroma has steeped the old city for a millennium.
shaoxing.geography_zh: 绍兴地处浙东水乡，鉴湖之畔，河道纵横、桥梁密布，是典型的江南桥乡。
shaoxing.geography_en: Shaoxing lies in the water country of eastern Zhejiang, beside Jianhu Lake, its crisscrossing canals spanned by countless bridges in classic Jiangnan style.
shaoxing.climate_zh: 属亚热带季风气候，湿润温和，春秋两季最宜游览。
shaoxing.climate_en: The climate is subtropical monsoonal, humid and mild, with spring and autumn the finest seasons.
food_en: Braised pork with preserved mustard greens

guide_zh.title: 鲁迅故里·沈园
items: 上午逛鲁迅故里，从百草园到三味书屋，重读课本里的少年鲁迅。
午后游沈园，在《钗头凤》碑前重温陆游与唐婉的千古绝唱。
傍晚在咸亨酒店要一碟茴香豆、一碗黄酒，当一回孔乙己。

guide_zh.title: 兰亭·东湖
items: 上午赴兰亭，在曲水流觞处临摹《兰亭集序》，寻访书圣遗风。
下午游东湖，乘乌篷船穿行于悬崖峭壁之间，看采石遗迹的奇观。

guide_zh.title: 安昌古镇
items: 全天漫游安昌古镇，沿老街看晾晒的酱鸭腊肠，坐一坐手摇乌篷船。
在镇上吃一碗梅干菜扣肉，配一壶黄酒，感受最地道的绍兴滋味。

guide_en.title: Lu Xun's Former Residence · Shen Garden
items: Walk through Lu Xun's former home, from the Hundred-Plant Garden to the Three Flavor Study, reliving the schoolbook boyhood of the great writer.
In the afternoon, visit Shen Garden and stand before the Chaitou Feng wall, where the parting verses of Lu You and Tang Wan are carved.
Come evening, order fennel beans and a bowl of yellow rice wine at the Xianheng Tavern, just like Kong Yiji.

guide_en.title: Orchid Pavilion · East Lake
items: Drive to the Orchid Pavilion in the morning and try your hand at calligraphy beside the winding stream where the sage of calligraphy once floated wine cups.
In the afternoon, take a black-awning boat through the sheer quarry cliffs of East Lake.

guide_en.title: Anchang Ancient Town
items: Spend a full day in Anchang Ancient Town, walking the old street hung with drying soy-braised ducks and sausages, and ride a hand-rowed wupeng boat.
Finish with braised pork and preserved mustard greens washed down with a pot of Shaoxing wine.

jingzhou.tagline_en: A storied city of the Three Kingdoms and the ancient capital of Chu
jingzhou.history_zh: 荆州古称江陵，曾是春秋战国时期楚国的都城所在地，纪南城遗址即当年郢都故地。三国时期荆州成为魏、蜀、吴争夺的焦点，刘备借荆州、关羽失荆州的故事千古流传。自古江陵便是兵家必争之地，古城墙历经千年风雨仍巍然屹立。
jingzhou.history_en: Jingzhou, known in antiquity as Jiangling, was the site of the Chu state's capital in the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods, the Jinan City ruins being the remains of ancient Ying. During the Three Kingdoms era, Jingzhou lay at the heart of the struggle between Wei, Shu and Wu — Liu Bei borrowing Jingzhou and Guan Yu losing it are among the most famous episodes of the age. Always a place contested by armies, Jiangling's city wall still stands strong after more than a thousand years.
jingzhou.geography_zh: 荆州地处江汉平原，位于长江北岸、荆江之畔，河湖密布，是鱼米之乡。
jingzhou.geography_en: Jingzhou lies on the Jianghan Plain, on the north bank of the Yangtze along the Jingjiang reach, amid a web of rivers and lakes in a land of fish and rice.
jingzhou.climate_zh: 属亚热带季风气候，湿润温和，春秋两季最宜游览。
jingzhou.climate_en: The climate is subtropical monsoonal, humid and mild, with spring and autumn the best seasons to visit.
attractions_en: Jinan City Ruins of the Chu State

guide_zh.title: 古城墙·荆州博物馆
items: 上午登荆州古城墙，走过瓮城，俯瞰护城河与老城街巷。
下午参观荆州博物馆，看战国丝绸与漆器，惊叹楚文化的华美。

guide_zh.title: 关帝庙·张居正故居
items: 上午拜关帝庙，追忆关羽镇守荆州的忠义岁月。
午后访张居正故居，了解一代名相推行「一条鞭法」的改革人生。

guide_zh.title: 纪南城遗址·夜游护城河
items: 上午前往楚纪南城遗址，在残垣夯土间遥想郢都气象。
傍晚沿护城河散步，乘画舫夜游，看古城灯火倒映水中。

guide_en.title: Ancient City Wall · Jingzhou Museum
items: Walk the ancient city wall in the morning, pass through the barbican and look down over the moat and the old lanes.
In the afternoon, visit Jingzhou Museum, where Warring States silks and lacquerware showcase the splendor of Chu culture.

guide_en.title: Guan Yu Temple · Zhang Juzheng's Former Residence
items: Pay homage at Guan Yu Temple, recalling the loyal general who held Jingzhou.
Then visit the former residence of Zhang Juzheng, the Ming grand secretary behind the Single Whip tax reform.

guide_en.title: Jinan City Ruins · Night Cruise on the Moat
items: In the morning, head to the Jinan City ruins of the Chu capital and imagine ancient Ying amid the rammed-earth remains.
In the evening, stroll the moat and board a painted boat for a night cruise beneath the lit-up walls.

xiangyang.tagline_zh: 铁打的襄阳，华夏第一城池
xiangyang.tagline_en: Iron-clad Xiangyang, the foremost fortified city of China
xiangyang.history_zh: 襄阳地处南北要冲，春秋战国时为楚国北方门户，号称「楚之北津」。汉末刘备三顾茅庐，诸葛亮在古隆中定下三分天下的「隆中对」。南宋末年，襄阳军民坚守孤城六年，宋元襄阳之战名垂青史。金庸笔下的郭靖、黄蓉守襄阳，更让这座城成为无数人心中的侠义之城。
xiangyang.history_en: Sitting astride the great north-south arteries of China, Xiangyang was the northern gateway of the Chu state in the Spring and Autumn period. At the end of the Han dynasty, Liu Bei made three visits to a thatched cottage, where Zhuge Liang set out the Longzhong Plan that would divide the realm into three kingdoms. In the waning years of the Southern Song, the city held out against the Mongol siege for six years in the famous Battle of Xiangyang. Jin Yong's novels, in which Guo Jing and Huang Rong defend the city, have made it a city of chivalry in the popular imagination.
xiangyang.geography_zh: 襄阳地处汉水中游，岘山为屏，自古「南船北马」，是南北交通的咽喉。
xiangyang.geography_en: Xiangyang lies on the middle Han River, shielded by Mount Xian, where boats from the south and horses from the north once changed hands at this linchpin of north-south transport.
xiangyang.climate_zh: 属北亚热带季风气候，四季分明，春秋两季最宜出行。
xiangyang.climate_en: The climate is northern subtropical monsoonal with four distinct seasons; spring and autumn are the best times to travel.

guide_zh.title: 古城墙·北街
items: 上午登襄阳古城墙，在夫人城上俯瞰汉水绕城，感受「铁打的襄阳」。
午后逛北街仿古商业街，买一份大头菜，尝一碗地道襄阳牛肉面。

guide_zh.title: 古隆中·米公祠
items: 上午赴古隆中，走进三顾堂与草庐亭，重温隆中对的千古韬略。
下午访米公祠，在宋代书画家米芾的祠堂里赏碑刻、观字画。

guide_zh.title: 唐城·汉江夜游
items: 上午游唐城影视基地，在盛唐街景中穿汉服拍照，看一场实景演出。
傍晚乘船夜游汉江，两岸灯火璀璨，古城墙如长龙卧波。

guide_en.title: Ancient City Wall · North Street
items: Climb the ancient city wall in the morning and look out from Lady Furen's Tower over the Han River — this is the iron Xiangyang.
In the afternoon, wander the antique North Street, pick up some pickled root mustard and try a bowl of Xiangyang beef noodles.

guide_en.title: Ancient Longzhong · Mi Fu Memorial Temple
items: Visit Ancient Longzhong in the morning, walking into the Three Visits Hall and the Thatched Pavilion where the Longzhong Plan was laid.
In the afternoon, call at the Mi Fu Memorial Temple to admire its stele inscriptions and calligraphy.

guide_en.title: Tang City · Han River Night Cruise
items: Spend the morning at the Tang City film studio, donning Tang costume among the sets and catching a live show.
As dusk falls, cruise the Han River by boat, with the lit city wall stretched along the water like a dragon.

datong.tagline_en: The Pingcheng of the Northern Wei and a Buddhist realm of Yungang
datong.history_zh: 大同古称平城，北魏在此建都将近百年，开启了中国北方石窟造像的先声。云冈石窟由皇家主持开凿，五万余尊造像见证佛教艺术东传的辉煌，早已列入世界遗产。辽金两代大同为西京陪都，华严寺至今保存着辽金建筑的精粹。
datong.history_en: Datong, known in antiquity as Pingcheng, served as the Northern Wei capital for nearly a century, ushering in the great age of cave-temple art in northern China. The Yungang Grottoes, carved under imperial patronage, hold over fifty thousand statues that bear witness to Buddhism's eastward flowering, and are inscribed as World Heritage. As the Western Capital of the Liao and Jin, the city preserves the finest of Liao-Jin architecture in Huayan Temple.
datong.geography_zh: 大同地处晋北高原，桑干河畔，扼内外长城之间，自古为游牧与农耕文明的交汇地带。
datong.geography_en: Datong lies on the plateau of northern Shanxi, beside the Sanggan River and between the inner and outer Great Walls, where the nomadic and agrarian worlds once met.
datong.climate_zh: 属温带半干旱季风气候，夏季凉爽、冬季寒冷，是华北著名的避暑胜地。
datong.climate_en: The climate is temperate semi-arid monsoonal, with cool summers that make the city a renowned summer retreat in North China, and cold winters.

guide_zh.title: 云冈石窟·华严寺
items: 全天朝圣云冈石窟，在昙曜五窟前仰望大佛的微笑，感受北魏皇家气象。
傍晚参观华严寺，看辽代薄伽教藏殿与合掌露齿菩萨。

guide_zh.title: 悬空寺·恒山
items: 清晨赴悬空寺，看这座千年古寺如何挂在恒山峭壁之上。
午后登北岳恒山，乘索道而上，在山顶道观远眺塞上风光。

guide_zh.title: 古城墙·九龙壁
items: 上午登大同古城墙，租一辆自行车环城骑行，俯瞰城内钟楼鼓楼。
午后看代王府前的九龙壁，五彩琉璃巨龙栩栩如生。
晚上到面馆吃一碗地道刀削面，再尝一份浑源凉粉。

guide_en.title: Yungang Grottoes · Huayan Temple
items: Devote the day to the Yungang Grottoes, standing before the Five Tanyao Caves to gaze up at the serene smiles of the Northern Wei Buddhas.
Back in town, visit Huayan Temple in the late afternoon to see the Liao-dynasty scripture hall and its smiling Bodhisattva.

guide_en.title: Hanging Temple · Mount Heng
items: Drive to the Hanging Temple early to see this thousand-year-old monastery pinned to a sheer cliff face.
In the afternoon, ride the cable car up Mount Heng, one of the five sacred mountains, and take in the frontier views from its Daoist temples.

guide_en.title: City Wall · Nine-Dragon Screen
items: Rent a bicycle on the rebuilt Datong city wall and ride the full circuit above the old town.
Afterwards, marvel at the glazed Nine-Dragon Screen in front of the Prince of Dai's palace.
Finish with a bowl of knife-cut noodles and a plate of Hunyuan bean jelly.

quanzhou.tagline_zh: 刺桐古城，海上丝路起点
quanzhou.tagline_en: The old city of Zayton and the starting point of the Maritime Silk Road
quanzhou.history_zh: 泉州古称刺桐，宋元时期是东方第一大港，被外国商人称为「Zayton」。马可·波罗在游记中盛赞它是世界上最大的港口之一，商船辐辏，万国云集。2021 年「泉州：宋元中国的世界海洋商贸中心」列入世界遗产，22 处史迹共同见证当年海上丝路的辉煌。
quanzhou.history_en: Quanzhou, known to the wider world as Zayton, was the greatest port of the East during the Song and Yuan dynasties, a name Arab merchants carried across the seas. Marco Polo praised it as one of the largest ports in the world, thronged with merchant ships from every land. In 2021, "Quanzhou: Emporium of the World in Song-Yuan China" was inscribed on the World Heritage List, with twenty-two sites testifying to the glory of the Maritime Silk Road.
quanzhou.geography_zh: 泉州地处闽南沿海，晋江入海口，群山环海，古港林立，兼具山海之利。
quanzhou.geography_en: Quanzhou lies on the coast of southern Fujian at the mouth of the Jin River, ringed by mountains and sea, with ancient harbors strung along the shore.
quanzhou.climate_zh: 属南亚热带季风气候，温暖湿润，冬无严寒，四季皆宜游览。
quanzhou.climate_en: The climate is southern subtropical monsoonal, warm and humid, with no harsh winter — a pleasant destination in any season.

guide_zh.title: 开元寺·西街
items: 上午游开元寺，看东西双塔与桑莲法界，感受「佛国」气象。
午后沿西街漫步，从钟楼到开元寺，一路打卡红砖古厝与市井小吃。
傍晚来一碗面线糊配油条，再来一份海蛎煎。

guide_zh.title: 清源山·洛阳桥
items: 上午登清源山，瞻仰老君岩造像，俯瞰泉州城与泉州湾。
下午访洛阳桥，看中国最早的跨海石梁桥如何以牡蛎固基。

guide_zh.title: 清净寺·崇武古城
items: 上午参观清净寺，这座千年伊斯兰古寺见证刺桐港的万国来客。
午后驱车前往崇武古城，登石城看海，吹一吹惠安的海风。

guide_en.title: Kaiyuan Temple · West Street
items: Visit Kaiyuan Temple in the morning to see its twin pagodas and the mulberry-lotus realm of this Buddhist landmark.
In the afternoon, wander West Street from the Bell Tower to Kaiyuan Temple, past red-brick arcades and street snacks.
At dusk, warm up with a bowl of mianxian hu and an oyster omelet.

guide_en.title: Qingyuan Mountain · Luoyang Bridge
items: Climb Qingyuan Mountain in the morning to see the great Laojun Rock statue and look out over the city and Quanzhou Bay.
In the afternoon, visit Luoyang Bridge, China's earliest cross-sea stone beam bridge, anchored by ingenious oyster-based foundations.

guide_en.title: Qingjing Mosque · Chongwu Ancient City
items: Visit the Qingjing Mosque, a thousand-year-old Islamic sanctuary that speaks of Zayton's cosmopolitan past.
Then drive to Chongwu Ancient City to walk its stone walls by the sea and feel the coastal breeze of Hui'an.

guangzhou.tagline_zh: 千年商都，海上丝路重港
guangzhou.tagline_en: A thousand-year merchant capital and a key port of the Maritime Silk Road
guangzhou.history_zh: 广州建城始于秦代的番禺城，迄今已有两千多年历史。唐宋时期设市舶司，广州成为海上丝绸之路的东方大港，中外商船云集。近代广州率先开埠，成为辛亥革命的策源地之一，留下了黄埔军校等革命史迹。如今广交会延续千年商脉，让广州始终站在中国对外贸易的前沿。
guangzhou.history_en: Guangzhou's history as a city began with Panyu, founded in the Qin dynasty more than two thousand years ago. In the Tang and Song, the Maritime Trade Office made it the great eastern port of the Maritime Silk Road, crowded with ships from distant lands. Opening as a treaty port in modern times, Guangzhou became a cradle of revolution, leaving sites such as the Whampoa Military Academy. Today the Canton Fair carries on a thousand-year mercantile tradition, keeping the city at the forefront of China's foreign trade.
guangzhou.geography_zh: 广州地处珠江三角洲北缘，白云山、越秀山环城而立，珠江穿城入海。
guangzhou.geography_en: Guangzhou sits on the northern edge of the Pearl River Delta, ringed by Baiyun and Yuexiu mountains, with the Pearl River flowing through the city to the sea.
guangzhou.climate_zh: 属南亚热带季风气候，长夏暖冬，「花城」四季花开如春。
guangzhou.climate_en: The climate is southern subtropical monsoonal, with long summers and mild winters that keep the "City of Flowers" in bloom all year round.

guide_zh.title: 陈家祠·沙面
items: 上午参观陈家祠，细赏岭南建筑的木雕、石雕与灰塑精品。
午后漫步沙面岛，在欧陆风情的老建筑与榕树浓荫间拍照。
晚上在珠江边吃一顿地道粤菜，白切鸡不可错过。

guide_zh.title: 越秀山·中山纪念堂·北京路
items: 上午登越秀山，与五羊石像合影，俯瞰广州老城。
午后参观中山纪念堂，感受这座中西合璧建筑的恢宏。
傍晚逛北京路，看玻璃罩下的千年古道，尝一碗肠粉。

guide_zh.title: 早茶·广州塔夜景
items: 清晨到老字号茶楼叹早茶，一盅两件，虾饺烧卖慢慢品。
入夜登广州塔，在「小蛮腰」之巅俯瞰珠江两岸灯火。
随后乘船夜游珠江，为旅程画上璀璨句号。

guide_en.title: Chen Clan Ancestral Hall · Shamian
items: Spend the morning at the Chen Clan Ancestral Hall, admiring the masterpieces of Lingnan wood carving, stone carving and lime sculpture.
In the afternoon, stroll Shamian Island among its European-style mansions and banyan shade.
In the evening, enjoy a proper Cantonese dinner by the Pearl River; don't miss the white-cut chicken.

guide_en.title: Yuexiu Mountain · Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall · Beijing Road
items: Climb Yuexiu Mountain in the morning for a photo with the Five Rams Statue and views over the old city.
In the afternoon, visit the grand Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, a striking blend of Chinese and Western architecture.
Come evening, walk Beijing Road and peer through glass panels at the thousand-year-old street beneath your feet, then sample some cheung fun.

guide_en.title: Dim Sum · Canton Tower by Night
items: Begin the day at a time-honored teahouse for yum cha — har gow, siu mai and a pot of pu'er, unhurried.
In the evening, ascend the Canton Tower to watch the lights of the Pearl River from the slender waist of the city.
Afterwards, cap the night with a Pearl River cruise.

shanghai.tagline_zh: 从渔村到魔都，开埠两百年
shanghai.tagline_en: From fishing village to magical metropolis, two centuries since its opening
shanghai.history_zh: 上海的历史可上溯至宋元时期的华亭，明代设上海县，起初只是长江口的一个小渔港。1843 年开埠后，上海迅速崛起为远东最大的都会，外滩的万国建筑群记录了那段风云岁月。1990 年浦东开发开放，陆家嘴天际线拔地而起，续写着这座城市日新月异的传奇。
shanghai.history_en: Shanghai's story reaches back to Huating of the Song and Yuan, and the county of Shanghai in the Ming, when it was little more than a fishing port at the mouth of the Yangtze. After opening as a treaty port in 1843, it rose swiftly to become the greatest metropolis of the Far East, a chapter written in the riverside architecture of the Bund. With the development of Pudong from 1990, the Lujiazui skyline has risen to continue the city's story of ceaseless transformation.
shanghai.geography_zh: 上海地处长江入海口，黄浦江穿城而过，江海交汇，襟江带海。
shanghai.geography_en: Shanghai sits at the estuary of the Yangtze, with the Huangpu River dividing the city where river meets sea.
shanghai.climate_zh: 属北亚热带季风气候，湿润多雨，梅雨季与台风季特色明显。
shanghai.climate_en: The climate is northern subtropical monsoonal, humid and rainy, marked by a distinct plum-rain season and late-summer typhoons.

guide_zh.title: 外滩·南京路
items: 上午沿外滩漫步，从万国建筑群一路看到陆家嘴天际线。
午后逛南京路步行街，在十里洋场的繁华里感受上海节奏。
入夜回到外滩看灯光秀，黄浦江两岸璀璨如昼。

guide_zh.title: 豫园·上海博物馆·武康路
items: 上午游豫园，逛九曲桥与城隍庙，尝一只南翔小笼包。
午后参观上海博物馆，看青铜器与书画的顶级馆藏。
傍晚沿武康路散步，在梧桐树下的老洋房间打卡武康大楼。

guide_zh.title: 朱家角古镇
items: 全天漫游朱家角古镇，坐乌篷船穿桥过巷，尝扎肉与阿婆粽。
午后在放生桥边的茶馆小坐，看江南水乡的慢时光。

guide_en.title: The Bund · Nanjing Road
items: Walk the Bund in the morning, from the grandeur of the historic buildings to the Lujiazui skyline across the river.
In the afternoon, shop the pedestrian stretch of Nanjing Road, the busiest street of old Shanghai.
Return to the Bund after dark for the light show, when both banks blaze like day.

guide_en.title: Yu Garden · Shanghai Museum · Wukang Road
items: Spend the morning in Yu Garden and the City God Temple, crossing the Nine-Turn Bridge and sampling Nanxiang soup dumplings.
In the afternoon, see the peerless bronzes and paintings of the Shanghai Museum.
Finish with an evening stroll along Wukang Road, stopping beneath the plane trees at the Wukang Mansion.

guide_en.title: Zhujiajiao Water Town
items: Devote the day to Zhujiajiao Water Town, riding a black-awning boat under the old stone bridges.
Try the local lotus-leaf braised pork and granny's zongzi, then idle in a teahouse by Fangsheng Bridge.

jiujiang.tagline_en: By the Xunyang River and at the foot of Mount Lu
jiujiang.history_zh: 九江古称浔阳，汉代已设浔阳县，东晋以后为江州治所。白居易贬谪江州时在此写下千古名篇《琵琶行》，「浔阳江头夜送客」传诵至今。九江还是陶渊明的故里，庐山脚下「悠然见南山」的诗意千年不散。近现代庐山会议在此召开，让这座名山见证了历史的转折。
jiujiang.history_en: Jiujiang, known in antiquity as Xunyang, was established as a county in the Han and became the seat of Jiangzhou after the Eastern Jin. Exiled here as an official, Bai Juyi composed his immortal poem The Song of the Pipa Player, whose opening line — "one night I bade farewell to a guest by the Xunyang River" — is recited to this day. Jiujiang is also the home of the pastoral poet Tao Yuanming, whose "leisurely I gaze at the southern hills" was inspired by these very slopes of Mount Lu. In modern times the mountain hosted the Lushan Conferences, witnessing pivotal turns of history.
jiujiang.geography_zh: 九江地处长江中游南岸，坐拥鄱阳湖口，庐山屹立城北，江湖山色融于一城。
jiujiang.geography_en: Jiujiang sits on the south bank of the middle Yangtze at the mouth of Poyang Lake, with Mount Lu rising to the north in a rare fusion of river, lake and mountain scenery.
jiujiang.climate_zh: 属中亚热带季风气候，湿润温和，庐山夏季凉爽，是著名的避暑胜地。
jiujiang.climate_en: The climate is middle subtropical monsoonal and humid; Mount Lu's cool summers have made it a celebrated retreat.
attractions_zh: 庐山（含鄱口/三叠泉/美庐）
attractions_en: Mount Lu (Hanpokou, the terrace overlooking Poyang Lake / Three-Step Waterfall / Meilu Villa)

guide_zh.title: 庐山牯岭·美庐
items: 上山入住牯岭镇，在「天上的街市」感受庐山的云中清凉。
下午参观美庐别墅，看当年蒋宋夫妇的避暑行宫与历史风云。
傍晚沿如琴湖散步，看云雾漫过花径。

guide_zh.title: 三叠泉·含鄱口
items: 上午徒步三叠泉，「不到三叠泉，不算庐山客」，看瀑布三级跌落。
午后登含鄱口，远眺鄱阳湖与汉阳峰，若遇云海便不虚此行。

guide_zh.title: 白鹿洞书院·浔阳楼
items: 上午下山访白鹿洞书院，在千年学府里感受朱子讲学的余韵。
下午回市区登浔阳楼，凭栏望江，吟一句「浔阳江头夜送客」。
傍晚游烟水亭，在甘棠湖畔看夕阳。

guide_en.title: Guling Town · Meilu Villa
items: Head up the mountain to Guling Town, the "street in the clouds", and cool off in its misty alpine charm.
In the afternoon, visit the Meilu Villa, the summer residence of Chiang Kai-shek and Soong Mei-ling, steeped in modern history.
In the evening, walk around Ruyi Lake as clouds drift over the Flower Path.

guide_en.title: Three-Step Waterfall · Hanpokou
items: Hike to the Three-Step Waterfall in the morning — no visit to Mount Lu is complete without seeing its triple drop.
In the afternoon, climb to Hanpokou, the terrace overlooking Poyang Lake, for sweeping views over the lake toward Hanyang Peak, especially when the sea of clouds rolls in.

guide_en.title: White Deer Grotto Academy · Xunyang Tower
items: Come down from the mountain to the White Deer Grotto Academy, one of China's four great ancient academies, where Zhu Xi once lectured.
Back in the city, climb Xunyang Tower to gaze over the Yangtze and recite a line of Bai Juyi's pipa poem.
End the day at the Yanshui Pavilion on Gantang Lake as the sun sets.

qufu.tagline_en: The holy city of the East and the hometown of Confucius
qufu.history_zh: 曲阜是春秋时期鲁国的都城，孔子在这里诞生、讲学并安葬。两千多年来，历代帝王不断加封扩建，形成规模宏大的孔庙、孔府、孔林，合称「三孔」，1994 年列入世界文化遗产。曲阜由此成为中华文化的圣地，被誉为「东方圣城」。
qufu.history_en: Qufu was the capital of the Lu state in the Spring and Autumn period, where Confucius was born, taught and laid to rest. Over two thousand years, successive emperors honored and enlarged the Temple of Confucius, the Kong Family Mansion and the Cemetery of Confucius — the Three Kong Sites, inscribed as World Heritage in 1994. Qufu thus became a sacred place of Chinese civilization, revered as the holy city of the East.
qufu.geography_zh: 曲阜地处鲁中南平原，泗水之滨，地势平坦，是一座典型的北方古城。
qufu.geography_en: Qufu lies on the plain of south-central Shandong, on the banks of the Si River, a classic northern city on level ground.
qufu.climate_zh: 属暖温带季风气候，四季分明，春秋两季最宜游览。
qufu.climate_en: The climate is warm-temperate monsoonal with four distinct seasons; spring and autumn are the best times to visit.

guide_zh.title: 孔庙·孔府
items: 上午谒孔庙，从金声玉振坊一路走到大成殿，感受千年礼制的庄严。
下午参观孔府，穿行于九进院落之间，看「天下第一家」的气派。

guide_zh.title: 孔林·颜庙
items: 上午游孔林，在古木参天间拜谒孔子墓，听风过碑林。
午后访颜庙，瞻仰复圣颜回，感受安贫乐道的君子之风。

guide_zh.title: 尼山圣境
items: 全天前往尼山圣境，登尼山看孔子诞生地，仰望七十二米高的孔子像。
夜晚看《金声玉振》礼乐演出，在山水之间重温圣贤之道。

guide_en.title: Temple of Confucius · Kong Family Mansion
items: Pay homage at the Temple of Confucius in the morning, passing the Jinsheng Yuzhen Arch to the Hall of Great Achievement.
In the afternoon, tour the Kong Family Mansion, home to generations of the sage's descendants — the First Family Under Heaven.

guide_en.title: Confucius Forest · Temple of Yan Hui
items: Walk the Confucius Forest in the morning, among ancient trees, to bow before the grave of the sage.
In the afternoon, visit the Temple of Yan Hui, honoring the sage's favorite disciple and his spirit of contented simplicity.

guide_en.title: Nishan Sacred Land
items: Spend the day at Nishan Sacred Land, the birthplace of Confucius, and stand beneath the towering 72-meter statue of the sage.
Stay for the evening ritual music show, a spectacle of rites and music amid the mountain landscape.

dunhuang.tagline_en: A pearl of the Silk Road and a Buddhist realm in the desert
dunhuang.history_zh: 汉武帝开河西四郡，敦煌由此登上历史舞台，成为丝绸之路上的咽喉要地。玉门关、阳关一北一南，见证无数商旅与征人西出阳关。莫高窟自十六国起营造千年，735 个洞窟、四万五千平方米壁画堪称沙漠中的艺术宝库。1900 年藏经洞被发现，五万余卷文书震惊世界，敦煌学由此诞生。
dunhuang.history_en: When Emperor Wu of Han established the four commanderies of the Hexi Corridor, Dunhuang stepped onto the stage of history as a linchpin of the Silk Road. The Yumen and Yang passes, north and south, watched countless caravans and soldiers go west. The Mogao Caves, carved over a thousand years beginning in the Sixteen Kingdoms era, hold 735 grottoes and 45,000 square meters of murals — an art treasury in the desert. The discovery of the Library Cave in 1900, with over 50,000 manuscripts, astounded the world and gave birth to Dunhuang studies.
dunhuang.geography_zh: 敦煌地处河西走廊最西端，党河滋润出一片绿洲，鸣沙山环抱城郭，大漠与清泉并存。
dunhuang.geography_en: Dunhuang lies at the far western end of the Hexi Corridor, where the Dang River waters an oasis embraced by the Mingsha dunes — desert and spring in one landscape.
dunhuang.climate_zh: 属温带大陆性干旱气候，降水稀少，昼夜温差大，春秋两季最宜出行。
dunhuang.climate_en: The climate is temperate continental and arid, with scant rainfall and wide day-night temperature swings; spring and autumn are the best times to visit.

guide_zh.title: 莫高窟·鸣沙山月牙泉
items: 上午按预约参观莫高窟，先在数字中心观影，再进洞窟看壁画与彩塑，一场千年的朝圣。
傍晚登鸣沙山，滑沙而下，看月牙泉在夕阳下如新月静卧。
入夜可参加沙漠露营，仰望大漠星空。

guide_zh.title: 玉门关·雅丹地质公园
items: 上午西行至玉门关，在汉代关城与汉长城遗址前怀想「春风不度玉门关」。
午后深入雅丹地质公园，乘观光车穿行「魔鬼城」，看风蚀地貌的鬼斧神工。

guide_zh.title: 阳关·敦煌夜市
items: 上午赴阳关，登烽燧远眺戈壁，「西出阳关无故人」的苍凉尽在眼前。
晚上逛敦煌夜市，吃驴肉黄面、喝杏皮水，淘几件敦煌文创。

guide_en.title: Mogao Caves · Mingsha Mountain & Crescent Spring
items: Visit the Mogao Caves on a pre-booked tour, watching the films at the digital center before entering the grottoes of murals and statues — a thousand-year pilgrimage.
In the late afternoon, climb Mingsha Mountain and slide down the dunes, then watch the sunset gild the Crescent Spring.
Optional: join a desert camp and sleep beneath the starry skies of the Gobi.

guide_en.title: Yumen Pass · Yardang National Geopark
items: Drive west to Yumen Pass in the morning and stand before the Han-dynasty fort, where "the spring breeze never reaches".
In the afternoon, enter the Yardang Geopark and ride through the wind-carved Ghost City of strange rock formations.

guide_en.title: Yang Pass · Dunhuang Night Market
items: Head to Yang Pass in the morning and climb its beacon tower to gaze over the gravel desert, the very scene of "west of Yang Pass, no old friends".
In the evening, wander the night market, feasting on donkey-meat noodles and apricot drink and browsing Dunhuang souvenirs.

kashgar.tagline_zh: 丝路西陲重镇，西域风情之都
kashgar.tagline_en: A key town on the western edge of the Silk Road and a capital of Central Asian charm
kashgar.history_zh: 喀什古称疏勒，汉代已见于史册，是古丝路南北两道在西域的交汇点。两千年来，商队、使节与僧侣在此驻足，东西方文明在此握手。清代喀什噶尔回城盛极一时，香妃的传说更让这座城增添了几分传奇色彩。
kashgar.history_en: Kashgar, known in antiquity as Shule, appears in Chinese annals as early as the Han dynasty, at the junction where the northern and southern routes of the Silk Road met in the Western Regions. For two millennia caravans, envoys and monks paused here, and East and West clasped hands. In Qing times the walled city of Kashgar flourished, and the legend of Xiang Fei, the Fragrant Concubine, has lent the city an extra touch of romance.
kashgar.geography_zh: 喀什地处塔里木盆地西缘绿洲，东北望帕米尔高原，是南疆的门户。
kashgar.geography_en: Kashgar lies on an oasis at the western rim of the Tarim Basin, facing the Pamir Plateau — the gateway to southern Xinjiang.
kashgar.climate_zh: 属暖温带大陆性干旱气候，日照充足，昼夜温差大，春秋两季最宜游览。
kashgar.climate_en: The climate is warm-temperate continental and arid, with abundant sunshine and wide day-night temperature swings; spring and autumn are the finest seasons to visit.
attractions_en: Scenery along the China–Pakistan Friendship Highway

guide_zh.title: 老城·艾提尕尔清真寺
items: 上午漫步喀什老城，穿梭于迷宫般的小巷与土黄色民居之间。
午后参观艾提尕尔清真寺，感受南疆最大清真寺的宁静与庄严。
傍晚在百年老茶馆喝一壶茶，听维吾尔族老人弹唱热瓦普。

guide_zh.title: 香妃园·国际大巴扎
items: 上午游香妃园，在清真寺式陵墓与花园之间听香妃的传说。
午后逛中西亚国际大巴扎，淘铜器、花帽与干果，感受千年商埠的烟火。

guide_zh.title: 帕米尔高原一日（白沙湖·慕士塔格）
items: 沿中巴友谊公路西行，先到白沙湖，看白沙山倒映在碧蓝湖水中。
远眺慕士塔格峰，在喀拉库勒湖畔仰望「冰山之父」。
傍晚返回喀什，用一份烤包子和抓饭结束行程。

guide_en.title: Old Town · Id Kah Mosque
items: Get lost in the maze-like alleys of the Kashgar Old Town, among its earthen homes and carved balconies.
In the afternoon, visit the Id Kah Mosque, the largest in Xinjiang, and absorb its quiet dignity.
Finish the day at a century-old teahouse, sipping tea as Uyghur elders play the rawap.

guide_en.title: Fragrant Concubine Garden · Grand Bazaar
items: Visit the Fragrant Concubine Garden in the morning, wandering the mausoleum and its Islamic gardens steeped in legend.
In the afternoon, dive into the international grand bazaar for copperware, embroidered caps and dried fruit.

guide_en.title: A Day on the Pamir Plateau (White Sand Lake · Muztagh Ata)
items: Drive west along the China–Pakistan Friendship Highway to White Sand Lake, where white dunes mirror themselves in turquoise water.
Gaze up at Muztagh Ata, the Father of Ice Mountains, from the shores of Karakul Lake.
Return to Kashgar in the evening and close the trip with samsa and polo.

guilin.tagline_en: Guilin's scenery is the finest under heaven
guilin.history_zh: 秦始皇统一岭南后置始安郡，并开凿灵渠沟通湘江与漓江，桂林由此发端。唐代设桂州，成为岭南重镇，商旅辐辏。抗战时期大批文化名人云集于此，桂林被誉为「抗战文化城」。
guilin.history_en: After the First Emperor unified Lingnan, Shi'an Commandery was established here and the Ling Canal was cut to link the Xiang and Li rivers — the beginnings of Guilin. In the Tang the city became Guizhou Prefecture, a leading town of Lingnan thronged with merchants. During the War of Resistance a host of cultural luminaries gathered here, earning Guilin renown as a cultural capital of wartime China.
guilin.geography_zh: 桂林地处漓江两岸，喀斯特峰林拔地而起，岩溶地貌堪称世界典范。
guilin.geography_en: Guilin lies along both banks of the Li River, where karst peaks rise abruptly from the plain — one of the world's finest examples of karst landscape.
guilin.climate_zh: 属中亚热带季风气候，湿润宜人，4 至 10 月是最佳游览时节。
guilin.climate_en: The climate is middle subtropical monsoonal and humid, with April to October the best months to visit.

guide_zh.title: 象鼻山·两江四湖夜游
items: 上午游象鼻山公园，与桂林城徽象鼻山合影，看漓江在此绕山而过。
入夜乘船游两江四湖，看日月双塔与两岸灯影倒映水中。

guide_zh.title: 漓江游船·阳朔
items: 乘游船顺漓江而下，饱览九马画山、黄布倒影等百里画廊精华。
抵达阳朔后漫步西街，感受中西合璧的古镇风情。

guide_zh.title: 遇龙河骑行·龙脊梯田
items: 清晨沿遇龙河骑行，再乘竹筏漂流，看田园与峰林交映。
午后前往龙脊梯田，登观景台看层层梯田如天梯入云。

guide_en.title: Elephant Trunk Hill · Two Rivers and Four Lakes Night Cruise
items: Visit Elephant Trunk Hill in the morning and pose with Guilin's city emblem, watching the Li River sweep around the rock.
After dark, cruise the Two Rivers and Four Lakes to see the Sun and Moon Pagodas mirrored in the water.

guide_en.title: Li River Cruise · Yangshuo
items: Cruise downstream along the Li River past the Nine Horses Fresco Hill and the Yellow Cloth Shoal, the highlights of the hundred-li gallery.
On arrival in Yangshuo, wander West Street and soak up the East-meets-West atmosphere of the old town.

guide_en.title: Yulong River Cycling · Longji Rice Terraces
items: Cycle along the Yulong River in the early morning and drift downstream on a bamboo raft past fields and karst peaks.
Drive on to the Longji Rice Terraces in the afternoon and watch the stairways of paddies climb into the clouds.

lijiang.tagline_en: The Suzhou of the highlands and the ancient city of the Naxi
lijiang.history_zh: 元朝在此设丽江路，木氏土司世袭治理四百余年，纳西文化由此昌盛。作为茶马古道上的重镇，丽江自古马帮往来、四方辐辏。1997 年丽江古城列入世界文化遗产，活态古城延续至今。
lijiang.history_en: In the Yuan dynasty the region was organized as Lijiang Circuit, and the Mu chieftains governed it for more than four hundred years, nurturing a flourishing Naxi culture. A key post on the Ancient Tea Horse Road, Lijiang long echoed with the bells of mule caravans. In 1997 its old town was inscribed as a World Heritage site and remains a living ancient city to this day.
lijiang.geography_zh: 丽江地处云贵高原，位于玉龙雪山脚下、金沙江畔，雪山与古城朝夕相望。
lijiang.geography_en: Lijiang lies on the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain and beside the Jinsha River, with the snow peaks gazing down on the old town.
lijiang.climate_zh: 属高原季风气候，冬暖夏凉，四季如春，一年皆可游览。
lijiang.climate_en: The climate is plateau monsoonal, with mild winters and cool summers — a city of eternal spring, pleasant in any season.

guide_zh.title: 丽江古城·黑龙潭
items: 上午漫步丽江古城，走石板路、过小桥流水，认一认店铺匾额上的东巴文字。
下午到黑龙潭公园，在玉龙雪山的倒影前拍下经典画面。
晚上在四方街听纳西古乐，感受古城的夜色与热闹。

guide_zh.title: 玉龙雪山
items: 全天游览玉龙雪山，乘大索道登冰川公园，看雪峰近在咫尺。
午后下山看《印象丽江》实景演出，或到蓝月谷看湖水蓝如宝石。

guide_zh.title: 束河古镇或泸沽湖
items: 上午去束河古镇，在比大研更安静的老街上寻找茶马古道的遗迹。
若时间充裕，再驱车前往泸沽湖，乘猪槽船看摩梭人家的山水。

guide_en.title: Lijiang Old Town · Black Dragon Pool
items: Wander the cobbled lanes of the old town in the morning, crossing its canals and tracing the Naxi Dongba script on the shop signs.
In the afternoon, visit Black Dragon Pool Park for the classic photograph of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain mirrored in the water.
In the evening, listen to ancient Naxi music by Sifang Square and soak up the old town after dark.

guide_en.title: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain
items: Spend the day on Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, riding the cableway up to Glacier Park with the peaks at arm's reach.
Come back down for the Impression Lijiang show, or linger by the sapphire waters of Blue Moon Valley.

guide_en.title: Shuhe Ancient Town or Lugu Lake
items: Visit Shuhe Ancient Town in the morning, a quieter Tea Horse Road post of sleepy lanes and old bridges.
With more time, drive on to Lugu Lake and ride a dugout canoe across the waters of the Mosuo people.

dali.tagline_en: Wind, flowers, snow and moon — the old heartland of Nanzhao
dali.history_zh: 大理曾是南诏国的太和城，又是大理国的都城，段氏在此立国三百余年。苍山洱海间的这片土地，因金庸《天龙八部》而为无数读者心向往之。如今崇圣寺三塔依然矗立，见证着千年佛都的辉煌。
dali.history_en: Dali was home to the Taihe City of Nanzhao and later the capital of the Dali Kingdom, where the Duan clan ruled for more than three hundred years. This land between the Cangshan Mountains and Erhai Lake was made famous by Jin Yong's martial-arts epic Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils. The Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple still stand, monuments to a Buddhist capital of a thousand years.
dali.geography_zh: 大理位于苍山与洱海之间，高原湖泊与皑皑雪山相映成趣。
dali.geography_en: Dali lies between the Cangshan Mountains and Erhai Lake, where a highland lake mirrors a snow-crowned range.
dali.climate_zh: 属高原季风气候，四季温差小，春秋两季最佳。
dali.climate_en: The climate is plateau monsoonal with little seasonal temperature swing; spring and autumn are the finest seasons.

guide_zh.title: 古城·崇圣寺三塔
items: 上午逛大理古城，沿复兴路走到五华楼，感受南诏故都的闲适。
下午瞻仰崇圣寺三塔，看千年古塔倒映于三塔倒影池。

guide_zh.title: 洱海环湖
items: 租车或骑行环洱海，从才村码头到双廊，一路湖光山色。
傍晚在洱海边看一场日落，远眺苍山十九峰。

guide_zh.title: 苍山·喜洲古镇
items: 上午乘索道上苍山，走玉带云游路，俯瞰洱海全景。
下午访喜洲古镇，看白族三坊一照壁民居，尝一块破酥粑粑。

guide_en.title: Old Town · Three Pagodas
items: Stroll the old town in the morning, following Fuxing Road to Wuhua Tower and soaking up the ease of the old Nanzhao capital.
In the afternoon, admire the Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple, mirrored in the reflection pool.

guide_en.title: Around Erhai Lake
items: Rent a car or bicycle to circle Erhai Lake from Caicun Pier to Shuanglang, with lake and mountain views all the way.
Stay for sunset on the shore, looking across the water to the nineteen peaks of the Cangshan range.

guide_en.title: Cangshan Mountains · Xizhou Old Town
items: Take the cableway up Cangshan in the morning and walk the Jade Belt Cloud Path high above the lake.
In the afternoon, visit Xizhou to see the Bai courtyards with their three rooms and one screen wall, and try a crispy Xizhou baba.

lasa.tagline_en: The City of Sunlight and the holy palace of the snowland
lasa.history_zh: 拉萨古称逻些，是吐蕃王朝的都城。松赞干布统一青藏高原后在此建大昭寺，并迎娶文成公主入藏，开启了汉藏交往的千年篇章。布达拉宫依红山而建，历经千年营建，至今仍是雪域高原最宏伟的圣殿。
lasa.history_en: Lhasa, recorded in old Chinese annals as Luoxie, was the capital of the Tubo kingdom. After unifying the Tibetan plateau, Songtsen Gampo founded the Jokhang Temple here and welcomed Princess Wencheng of the Tang, opening a thousand years of ties between Tibet and the Central Plains. The Potala Palace, raised on Red Hill over the centuries, remains the grandest shrine of the snowland.
lasa.geography_zh: 拉萨地处拉萨河谷，海拔约 3650 米，群山环绕，是世界上海拔最高的城市之一。
lasa.geography_en: Lhasa lies in the Lhasa River valley at about 3,650 meters above sea level, ringed by mountains — one of the highest cities in the world.
lasa.climate_zh: 属高原温带半干旱气候，日照强烈，素有「日光城」之称，夏季凉爽舒适。
lasa.climate_en: The climate is highland temperate and semi-arid, with intense sunshine that earns the city its name of Sunlight City, and cool, comfortable summers.

guide_zh.title: 布达拉宫·八廓街
items: 上午参观布达拉宫，沿之字形石阶上行，细看白宫红宫与灵塔金顶。
傍晚转八廓街，随朝圣者绕大昭寺转经，感受拉萨的信仰日常。

guide_zh.title: 大昭寺·罗布林卡
items: 上午朝拜大昭寺，瞻仰释迦牟尼十二岁等身像，再登殿顶远眺布达拉宫。
下午游罗布林卡，在达赖夏宫的园林里看藏式宫殿与古木繁花。

guide_zh.title: 色拉寺辩经或纳木错一日
items: 午后到色拉寺看僧人辩经，击掌顿足的场面震撼人心。
若预留一天，可包车前往纳木错，看念青唐古拉山下的天湖圣境。

guide_en.title: Potala Palace · Barkhor Street
items: Visit the Potala Palace in the morning, climbing its zigzag stone steps through the White and Red Palaces to the golden stupas.
In the evening, walk the Barkhor circuit with the pilgrims circling the Jokhang and feel the pulse of Lhasa's faith.

guide_en.title: Jokhang Temple · Norbulingka
items: Pay homage at the Jokhang Temple in the morning before the Jowo, the twelve-year-old image of Shakyamuni, and climb to the roof for a view of the Potala.
In the afternoon, wander Norbulingka, the Dalai Lamas' summer palace, through its Tibetan halls and old gardens.

guide_en.title: Sera Monastery Debate or a Namtso Day Trip
items: Watch the monks debate at Sera Monastery in the afternoon, a thunderous ritual of claps and stamping feet.
With a full day to spare, hire a car for Namtso, the heavenly lake beneath the Nyenchen Tanglha range.

zhangjiajie.tagline_en: Three thousand wondrous peaks and eight hundred graceful waters
zhangjiajie.history_zh: 张家界古称大庸，深藏武陵群山之中，长期不为外界所知。电影《阿凡达》中悬浮山的灵感正取自这里的峰林，让张家界一夜闻名世界。1992 年武陵源列入世界自然遗产，成为峰林地貌的世界名片。
zhangjiajie.history_en: Zhangjiajie, known in antiquity as Dayong, lay hidden among the Wuling Mountains and long remained unknown to the outside world. The floating mountains of the film Avatar were inspired by its sandstone pillars, catapulting the region to global fame overnight. In 1992 Wulingyuan was inscribed as a World Natural Heritage site, a global byword for pillar-and-peak landscapes.
zhangjiajie.geography_zh: 张家界地处武陵山脉，石英砂岩峰林拔地千尺，地貌之奇独一无二。
zhangjiajie.geography_en: Zhangjiajie lies in the Wuling Mountains, where quartz-sandstone pillars soar a thousand feet — a landscape unlike any other on earth.
zhangjiajie.climate_zh: 属中亚热带季风性山地气候，常年云雾缭绕，如临仙境。
zhangjiajie.climate_en: The climate is middle subtropical monsoonal and mountainous, often wrapped in cloud and mist that lend the peaks a fairy-tale air.

guide_zh.title: 森林公园（袁家界/哈利路亚山）
items: 乘百龙天梯上袁家界，看《阿凡达》「哈利路亚山」原型乾坤柱。
傍晚走迷魂台与天下第一桥，俯瞰云海间的三千奇峰。

guide_zh.title: 天门山玻璃栈道
items: 乘世界最长索道上天门山，走鬼谷栈道与玻璃栈道，脚下万丈深渊。
再乘穿山扶梯登天门洞，仰望飞机曾穿洞而过的奇观。

guide_zh.title: 大峡谷玻璃桥·宝峰湖
items: 走上大峡谷玻璃桥，在云端玻璃上体验心跳加速。
午后游宝峰湖，乘船穿行于高峡平湖之间，听土家山歌。

guide_en.title: Forest Park (Yuanjiajie / Hallelujah Mountain)
items: Ride the Bailong Elevator up to Yuanjiajie to see the Hallelujah Mountain of Avatar fame and the Sky-Kissing Pillar.
In the evening, walk the Maze Platform and the First Bridge Under Heaven, looking out over the sea of clouds among three thousand peaks.

guide_en.title: Tianmen Mountain Glass Skywalk
items: Ride the world's longest cableway up Tianmen Mountain and brave the cliff-hugging Guigu Plank Road and the glass skywalk.
Then take the escalator through the mountain to Tianmen Cave, the great arch through which stunt planes have flown.

guide_en.title: Grand Canyon Glass Bridge · Baofeng Lake
items: Step onto the Grand Canyon Glass Bridge and feel your pulse race above the void.
In the afternoon, cruise Baofeng Lake between towering cliffs, serenaded by Tujia folk songs.

huangshan.tagline_zh: 五岳归来不看山，黄山归来不看岳
huangshan.tagline_en: Having seen the Five Great Mountains, no other mountains matter; having seen Huangshan, none at all
huangshan.history_zh: 黄山所在的徽州，是徽商故里，粉墙黛瓦的徽派建筑闻名天下。明代旅行家徐霞客两次登临黄山，留下「五岳归来不看山，黄山归来不看岳」的千古赞语。山脚下的宏村、西递等古村落，将徽州古韵完整保存至今。
huangshan.history_en: The Huizhou region around Huangshan was the homeland of the celebrated Hui merchants, whose whitewashed walls and dark-tiled Hui-style architecture spread across China. The Ming travel writer Xu Xiake climbed the mountain twice and left the immortal verdict: after the Five Great Mountains, no other peaks are worth seeing, and after Huangshan, even they are not. The ancient villages of Hongcun and Xidi at its foot preserve old Huizhou in its entirety.
huangshan.geography_zh: 黄山地处皖南，花岗岩峰林奇秀，以奇松、怪石、云海、温泉「四绝」著称。
huangshan.geography_en: Huangshan lies in southern Anhui, its granite peaks famed for the Four Wonders: strangely shaped pines, fantastical rocks, the sea of clouds and hot springs.
huangshan.climate_zh: 属亚热带山地气候，四季景致各异，冬季雪景尤为动人。
huangshan.climate_en: The climate is subtropical and mountainous, each season painting its own scenery, with winter snowscapes especially enchanting.
attractions_zh: 黄山风景区（光明顶/迎客松/西海大峡谷）
attractions_en: Huangshan Scenic Area (Bright Summit / Greeting Pine / Xihai Grand Canyon)

guide_zh.title: 上山（迎客松·光明顶日落）
items: 乘缆车上山，先与迎客松合影，看千年奇松张开双臂。
傍晚登光明顶看日落，云霞给群峰镀上金边，堪称绝景。

guide_zh.title: 西海大峡谷·云海日出
items: 清晨守一场日出，看云海翻腾、朝阳跃出天际。
白天走西海大峡谷，沿悬崖栈道盘旋而下，奇松怪石扑面而来。

guide_zh.title: 宏村·西递徽派古村
items: 下山后前往宏村，看月沼与南湖的水墨倒影。
下午访西递，走石板巷看徽派马头墙与精美木雕。

guide_en.title: Up the Mountain (Greeting Pine · Sunset at Bright Summit)
items: Take the cableway up and greet the Greeting Pine, its ancient arms thrown open to visitors.
Climb to Bright Summit in the late afternoon and watch the sunset gild the peaks.

guide_en.title: Xihai Grand Canyon · Sunrise and Sea of Clouds
items: Rise early for sunrise, when the sea of clouds surges beneath a glowing horizon.
Spend the day descending the Xihai Grand Canyon along cliffside trails among twisted pines and fantastical rocks.

guide_en.title: Hongcun & Xidi Ancient Villages
items: After descending, head to Hongcun to see its ink-wash reflections in Moon Pond and South Lake.
In the afternoon, wander Xidi's flagstone lanes past horse-head walls and exquisite wood carvings.
